scope: GAP-INGEST-006 partial-date precision. A month/year form keeps MONTH precision and is compared as a whole-month range (never a substituted day); complete dates keep DAY precision; invalid or malformed dates stay unresolved rather than becoming apparently-valid partial dates; a contradictory or untrusted partial date never manufactures a resolved decisive fact; a finding never implies more precision than its source. Implementation is closed by bf-gap-ingest-006 + aj-ingest-dates + z-general-intake; staging verification is pending.

tests.expected: a single month-only date reaches its field with MONTH precision and raw value; a contradiction is persistent and preserves every raw reading and owning location (A->B->A, A->B->C); a month plus a day never merges into a resolved anchor; invalid months stay unresolved; leap/non-leap February boundaries are correct; a month-only adverse anchor keeps raw month + MONTH precision into the result and the report never presents a range endpoint
a month-only anchor is a range: straddling withholds, wholly-before exceeds, wholly-inside does not; no first-day substitution
month/year forms normalize to MONTH precision
